title: anamnesis-assertion/v1
description: One curator's source-linked claim. An assertion never replaces the native record it was read from, and never strengthens its state. Every assertion carries the mapper that made it and the exact bytes it read.

kind.description: What the assertion is about. Submissions, canonical findings, occurrences, remediation attempts and verifications are separate records, never collapsed.

locator.description: Where in the source this was read from, so a reader can go back to the bytes.

native.description: The producer's own fields, unchanged. A normalised value never overwrites one of these.

confidence.description: The mapper's own confidence, or unknown when it does not report one.

state.description: The normalised state, held to closed enumerations per kind. proposed, applied, released, deployed, reverted and verified are independent: none implies another. unknown means the source never established it and is distinct from none and from not-applicable.

basis.description: The native text the state was read from, verbatim.
